packageRules.description: VanillaBP and the adapters follow the framework, not Renovate: their versions are bumped when a release is cut, and while they are snapshots there is nothing to look up. The Camunda 7 adapter of the module migration-tests is one of them.
Operaton fixes only its newest minor, with a patch every month, and this adapter follows it (decision 4 in DECISIONS.md). A patch comes in on its own.

A new Operaton minor needs a person: the adapter uses engine classes under '.impl.', which Operaton may change in any minor, the README names the version the adapter was tested with, and the recipe rewrite/vanillabp-operaton.yml pins the same minor. So it comes as a pull request to look at. Milestones and release candidates are left to the nightly build against the next Operaton.
